'''Marisa Kennedy''' is an American voice actress for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Kennedy has been acting since 2015, mostly playing minor roles in a couple of American TV shows. However, in 2017, she was cast in her best known role as the voice of [[island kahuna]] [[Olivia]] in {{aniseries|SM}} of the {{pkmn|animated series}}.
